View details – Opens the query details side pane where you can inspect the query, run
the query, or open the query in the editor.
For editable queries, more options are available:
Edit details – Opens the query details side pane with the option to edit the details like
description (if applicable) and the query itself. You can't edit the folder names (location)
of Microsoft Sentinel queries.
Delete – Deletes the query.
Rename – Allows you to modify the query name.
To help discover threats and anomalous behaviors in your environment, you can create
customized detection rules. There are two kinds:
Analytics rules - to generate detections from rules that query data that is ingested
through Microsoft Sentinel
Custom detection rules - to generate detections from rules that query data from
Defender XDR or from both Microsoft Sentinel and Defender XDR
For analytics rules that apply to data ingested through the connected Microsoft Sentinel
workspace, select Manage rules > Create analytics rule.

